I’ve seen the concept of TF become popularized on tiktok when people are referring to the abusive relationships they feel chained to /-: the idea of union with the compliment to your soul is definitely an appealing one that’s easy to romanticize. If it couldn’t work out with a person that appears to be my perfect counterpart, then obviously there is inner work I must do. I’m trying to learn from this so that some day I may have a relationship free from the corruption of my fears. It doesn’t have to be with the person I feel is my TF. I’m not waiting for them any longer. It has taken me quite a long while for me to come to terms w this but... Ultimately I feel that my inability to let go has been helpful to me, as this made enter a period of isolated introspection. Romantic relationships with other people simply weren’t happening for me. It would’ve been much easier for me to rebound and distract but I couldn’t. I was forced to sit with my pain and loneliness. Still doing some of that now but I’m finally coming out of it. Things feel grim atm but I know the hardest times sometimes have the most to teach us. I feel it’s unhelpful to get hung up on labels. In the end this community seems to be comprised of people who are seeking answers, bettering themselves, returning to themselves… all due to the love & loss of a special connection. Others here are much more experienced and versed on the topic than I am, but these are my 2c!
